english.note: Use 模型 as the all-purpose noun for a physical replica or a computer/statistical simulation.
Use this for a smaller-scale model of the original, such as a model car or building.

examples.english: This model was made based on a real bridge.
examples.traditional: 呢個模型係照住真橋整㗎。

examples.english: I bought a replica model of a sports car to put on my desk.
examples.traditional: 我買咗架跑車模型擺喺書枱上。
